entities.name: Table T1 – AI Data Center EV/Watt of Bitcoin Stocks
entities.brief: Bar chart of EV/Watt metrics for nine Bitcoin miners
entities.description: Shows EV per watt for nine Bitcoin miners using operational and development-inclusive metrics

properties.table_content:
| Company | Enterprise Value - $ per Watt (large, Op'l. and Under Construction) | Enterprise Value - $ per Watt (large, Op'l, Under Construction + Dev) |
|---|---|---|
| Marathon Digital (MARA) | $4.44 | $3.94 |
| Riot Blockchain (RIOT) | $2.98 | $1.82 |
| Cipher Mining (CIFR) | $6.77 | $2.18 |
| BitDeer Technologies (BTDR) | $1.93 | $1.32 |
| Galaxy Digital Holdings (GLXY) | $20.24 | $12.65 |
| Terawulf (WULF) | $10.59 | $2.44 |
| Core Scientific (CORZ) | $5.76 | $4.92 |
| Applied Digital (APLD) | $5.41 | $3.42 |
| HUT 8 (HUT) | $2.84 | $0.41 |
properties.key_insight: Including development-stage assets generally lowers EV/Watt, with HUT 8 showing the largest drop from $2.84 to $0.41
